summary.text: Patricia Gonzalez is a certified write-in, No Party Affiliation candidate for Florida's 24th Congressional District. She works as a mortgage broker and in her Ballotpedia survey calls herself an NPA candidate with Republican values. She has run for this seat before and lists protecting the Constitution, simpler homeownership and legal immigration among her priorities.

paragraphs.text: Gonzalez works as a mortgage broker.
She withdrew from the 2022 Republican primary for the 24th District, then lost the August 20, 2024 Republican primary to Jesus Navarro, 56.8% to 43.2%.
In 2026 she qualified as a write-in, No Party Affiliation candidate, describing herself as an NPA candidate with Republican values.
